df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
acct = df[df.account_id=='xykrZYR']

# compare each line item on 10-20 vs baseline (e.g. avg of nearby days)
base = acct[(acct.date>='2025-10-13')&(acct.date<='2025-10-19')]
key=['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
bmean = base.groupby(key).unblended_cost.mean().rename('base')
d20 = acct[acct.date=='2025-10-20'].set_index(key).unblended_cost.rename('oct20')
cmp = pd.concat([bmean,d20],axis=1).fillna(0)
cmp['diff']=cmp.oct20-cmp.base
print(cmp.sort_values('diff',ascending=False).head(15))
